events.title: Demo Hotfix – Respawn Hitbox Fix
events.summary: Hey everyone! We’ve released a small hotfix for the demo. Known Issue – Fixed: After a player was caught and respawned by a teammate, their hitbox could sometimes remain at the respawn point. Because of this, the player could still be caught from that location even after moving to another room. This issue has now been fixed. 🐾 - Tempest Games
